title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Azusa Pacific University
description: Verifiable late-night dining and snack destinations near Azusa Pacific University, including on-campus staples and local favorites open past 10 PM.

cards.title: Raising Cane's Chicken Fingers
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Chicken Fingers on Alosta
cards.notes: Grab a Box Combo at this popular spot located directly across from East Campus. It stays open until 2:00 AM or later most nights for late study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A high-traffic chicken finger chain located on Alosta Avenue, known for its signature sauce and late-night operating hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane's in Azusa at 855 E Alosta Ave is open until 2:00 AM Sunday-Wednesday and 3:30 AM Thursday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Azusa, CA, - 855 E Alosta Ave
cards.access_notes: Open until 2:00 AM Sun-Wed; 3:30 AM Thu-Sat.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger
cards.subtitle: The Classic SoCal Late-Night Burger
cards.notes: Visit this Alosta Avenue location for a Double-Double. It is a primary destination for students seeking a reliable meal after evening events.
cards.short_summary: A quintessential California fast-food staple located near the APU East Campus, offering burgers and shakes until at least 1:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: The In-N-Out Burger at 988 E. Alosta Ave. is open until 1:00 AM Sunday-Thursday and 1:30 AM Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Azusa, CA, 988 E. Alosta Ave.. - In-N-Out Burger
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM Sun-Thu; 1:30 AM Fri-Sat.

cards.title: The Donut Man
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Iconic Route 66 Donuts
cards.notes: Drive a few minutes east to this historic Route 66 landmark for fresh strawberry or peach donuts. It is open 24 hours a day for any late-night craving.
cards.short_summary: A world-famous donut shop in Glendora known for its seasonal fresh fruit-filled donuts and 24/7 service.
cards.evidence_claim: The original Donut Man location on Route 66 in Glendora is open 24 hours, 7 days a week.
cards.source_title: The Donut Man, Southern California's Best Donuts

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Tacos Near East Campus
cards.notes: Located on Alosta Avenue, this Taco Bell provides a quick and affordable late-night option for students living in nearby residence halls.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food restaurant offering Mexican-inspired fare with late-night drive-thru and dining hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 800 E Alosta in Azusa is open until 12:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Azusa, CA - 800 E Alosta

cards.title: Winchell's Donut House
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Coffee and Donuts
cards.notes: Stop by this 24-hour donut shop for a late-night coffee or bagel. It serves as a reliable spot for students during all-night study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour donut chain location in Azusa offering a variety of baked goods, sandwiches, and coffee.
cards.evidence_claim: Winchell's Donut House locations are generally open 24 hours a day, including the Azusa area locations.

cards.title: Denny's
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Diner Fare
cards.notes: Located just south of campus on Azusa Avenue, this diner offers a full menu of breakfast and dinner items 24 hours a day.
cards.short_summary: A classic 24-hour American diner providing a wide range of meals from breakfast slams to burgers.
cards.evidence_claim: The Denny's at 645 N Azusa Ave in West Covina is open 24 hours, 7 days a week.

cards.title: 7-Eleven
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Convenience and Snacks
cards.notes: A convenient stop for late-night snacks, drinks, and basic essentials. This location is open 24/7 and is easily accessible from the APU campus.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store offering a variety of grab-and-go food items and beverages.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 455 E. Foothill Blvd in Azusa is open 24 hours a day.

cards.title: 1899 Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Late-Night Dining
cards.notes: The primary dining hall on East Campus offers late-night options for students with meal plans. It is a central hub for evening community and food.
cards.short_summary: The main all-you-care-to-eat dining facility at APU, providing various food stations and late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: APU Dining Services notes that 1899 Dining Hall on East Campus offers late-night snacks and meals for students.
cards.source_title: APU Dining Services - Meal Plans and Campus Restaurants
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by semester; typically offers late-night service until 10:00 PM or later.

cards.title: Cornerstone Coffeehouse
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Coffee and Study Space
cards.notes: Located next to the Marshburn Memorial Library, this coffeehouse provides a late-night environment for caffeine and studying.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus coffee shop offering beverages and snacks with extended hours to support student study needs.
cards.evidence_claim: Cornerstone Coffeehouse is documented as being open until 8:00 PM or later during the academic year.
cards.source_title: Food for Thought - Azusa Pacific University
cards.access_notes: Open until 8:00 PM or later during standard semesters.

cards.title: The Habit Burger Grill
cards.subtitle: Charburgers and Shakes
cards.notes: A popular fast-casual choice for students, offering flame-grilled burgers and sides until 10:00 PM or later on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A fast-casual restaurant chain specializing in charbroiled burgers, located near the APU campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Habit Burger Grill in Azusa is open until 10:00 PM Sunday-Thursday and 11:00 PM Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Azusa - Charburgers - Salads - Sandwiches - Habit Burger & Grill
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM Sun-Thu; 11:00 PM Fri-Sat.
